issue_request: FHIR-3650 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 request to clarify Profile.extensionDefn.context formatting, especially that extension contexts should not be interpreted as semicolon-separated values in the conformance resource.
initial_application: The Jira records application in svn 4590. In git, 850a2eefa18974c4d92a10d81db711069ba7d65d (#3650) changed the obsolete ExtensionDefinition introduction table from semicolon-separated wording to one useContext element per context.
additional_context: The current build no longer contains source/extensiondefinition. source/fhir.ini actively lists structuredefinition=StructureDefinition, and the current StructureDefinition.context definition is repeatable, has context.type and context.expression children, and links to defining-extensions.html#context. Later source history reorganized and clarified this guidance, including ea10008f8a and FHIR-38630 commit 081c0d7685.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current source already avoids the old semicolon-separated format and documents element, extension, and fhirpath context formats on the active defining extensions page.
